leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a function to initialize date range state with start and end dates
Implement validation logic to ensure the start date precedes the end date
Apply date manipulation methods to calculate the duration between selected dates
Configure event handlers to update the date range based on user input
Integrate the date range logic with UI components to display selected dates
Manipulate date objects to format and parse dates for user interaction
Control the state flow to reset or modify the date range as needed
